title: 1st Company — The Firedrakes
subtitle: Vulkan's chosen veterans and the Legion's senior operational standard.
keywords: firedrakes veterans cooler booler toad kaladier absolute leadership

sections.h: Into the Fires of Battle, Unto the Anvil of War!
p: The Firedrakes are the battle-hardened veterans of the XVIIIth Legion. Forged in Nocturne's endless firestorms, they are famed for discipline, ferocity, and indomitable will. They are entrusted with the most dangerous missions and carry the prestige of Vulkan's chosen elite.

The company places equal emphasis on skill and character. A prospective Firedrake must work well with the company, Company Command, and Chapter Command. Operations expertise, reliability, maturity, and a high behavioral standard are central expectations.

Within the server, the Firedrakes represent the point where milsim expectations meet brotherhood. As the Veteran Company, in many ways they exemplify what success and greatness looks like in the 18th Legion.

list: Guide brothers in combat and in the community, correcting with humility and encouraging with strength.
Demonstrate mastery of operations and siege through Absolute-level victories.
Uphold the Promethean Creed through dignity, unity, discipline, and support for others.
Accept the responsibility of carrying both personal standards and the honor of the Legion.

notables: Master of the Firedrakes, Chapter Master Cooler da Booler

A long-standing and supporting member of the community, proving himself in battles too many to count. Beginning his journey long ago, he has faithfully and steadily been an unwavering example of both the compassion and wrath that our father Vulkan is known for.
Frequently seen sporting an Assault Intercessor toolset, choosing to wield a hammer like his father before him to dispatch the enemies of Mankind.
Along with the Pyre Guard, he serves as a confidant for Vulkan and a steady guiding hand for the community at large.
Firedrake Sergeant To'ad
A trusted right hand who balances command with camaraderie. Along with Cooler, he was one of the first members of First Company to pass the trials and be accepted.
Preferring to fight from a distance, To'ad will often be seen sporting his preferred Hellblaster to dispatch threats.
Firedrake Champion Kaladier
A shining example of the teaching of the Promethean Creed, Kaladier tirelessly works to push himself and his brothers in First Company to new heights.
Always eager to see others succeed alongside himself, he has frequently been among the first to volunteer to assist other companies.
Clad in his Intercessor loadout, he will rotate his weaponry from heavy bolter to Hellblaster depending on his team's strike needs.

title: 2nd Company — The Defenders of Nocturne
subtitle: Guardians of the Chapter homeworld, kin, and vulnerable Imperial populations.
keywords: defenders nocturne valk fulmetus draak guardian defense dreadnought

sections.h: Strength is not defined by what you can destroy, but what you can defend.
p: The Defenders of Nocturne are guardians of the Chapter's planetary home and kin. Lethal in attack and defense, combining relentless aggression against humanity's enemies with exceptional resilience when protecting their homeworld.

The 2nd Company exemplifies guardianship, protection of the weak, and selfless heroism. Its battle-brothers have forged a broad record of victories alongside Imperial allies in distant war zones. Their actions have spread the Chapter's reputation throughout the Imperium.

notables: Lieutenant Valk
A constant pillar of the company who leads through visible action. Often seen sporting the Intercessor loadout to give him a greater toolset.
Lieutenant Valk tirelessly works towards the success of the Second Company, often being the first and last one to say hello and good evening to everyone.
Fulmetus, Dreadnought of the Hearth
A veteran who guided the Chapter during its founding period, served as the first Captain of the 2nd Company.
As a Reiver — Captain Fulmetus was known for isolating the backline and removing high-value targets.
Upon his interment, he was placed in one of the Legion's most precious relics — a Saturnine Dreadnought rediscovered by Vulkan himself.
Veteran Sergeant Dra'ak
A veteran of countless battles and former Company Ancient. He combines extensive service with dedication to his brothers and a particular enthusiasm for bolters and bombs.
Ever present with the Intercessor loadout, he delivers death to the enemies of the Imperium of Man with ruthless efficiency.
Another bright spot in the coals, Dra'ak is known for going out of his way to help new recruits integrate into the community and company.

title: 3rd Company — The Pyroclasts
subtitle: Foremost flame specialists and the Chapter’s answer to entrenched enemies.
keywords: pyroclasts fogar rhorn foil draxxyx flame fire

sections.h: Where we walk only Ash remains.
p: The Salamanders are renowned for flame weapons, and the 3rd Company excels even by that standard. The Pyroclasts close with entrenched enemies and unleash purging fire. Their duty also includes the grim work of confronting populations condemned as heretical or aligned with xenos forces, balancing the Promethean commitment to humanity with loyalty to Vulkan and the Emperor.

The company takes pride in its flame-based identity and has established accolades built around flame weapons. Members often turn to fellow Pyroclasts first for assistance, strengthening the company's internal bonds.
Their outlook is captured by a simple challenge: certainty of death or a small chance of success — what are we waiting for?

notables: Captain Fo'gar Rhorn
A former Apothecary and 7th Company Sergeant who now leads his favored company. He is known across partner Legions and embodies the server’s chill-sim culture.
Preferring to lead from the front, he is often seen sporting a Storm Shield and Power Axe — defending his Marines from beside them.
Often known for being one of the first to greet visitors and brothers alike, and for his penchant for inhaling the fumes of his own forge.
Lieutenant Foil
Captain Fo'gar's first choice for Lieutenant, Foil has long been a support pillar for Third Company.
The Company's heavy weapons expert, Foil is often seen covering his fellow Marines on missions with belches of flame from his Multi-Melta.
Lieutenant Drax'xyx
The third member of the command triad for 3rd Company, Drax'xyx is another longtime community member.

Preferring to also fight from a distance, he is often seen with his Eliminator toolkit. Prioritizing high-value targets and those calling for aid, he makes sure that each squad he accompanies is protected from afar.

title: 4th Company — The Branded
subtitle: Faith, zeal, close combat, and the living edge of the Reclusiam.
keywords: branded chaplain igniax flusht pickle waffles hezonn faith zeal chainsword hammer

p: The Branded close with the enemy, strike, and endure. Where chainsword meets flesh and hammer breaks bone, they carry the Emperor's light directly into the foe.

The company is the living flame where devotion meets action and serves as a home for the Igniax Chaplains. Led by Master of Sanctity Lord Chaplain Flusht, its members are scarred by devotion and bound by oath. Every blow is a sermon, every victory a prayer, and every scar a holy mark.
The Branded call to those whose conviction is unshakable and whose spirit burns without end.

notables: Lieutenant Pickle
Right hand of the Captain, Lord Chaplain Flusht, Pickle is the ever present face of 4th Company.
Faithfully donning his Bladeguard retinue, the Lieutenant ensures that his Company members are never without a blade to stand beside them.
Veteran Sergeant Waffles
An unwavering fixture of 4th, Waffles is usually found assisting recruits become Battle Brothers, so they can start their journey in the 18th Legion.
An Intercessor main, he frequently will don the Assault toolkit to deliver death from the skies.
Veteran Sergeant Hezonn

Joining us from Italy, Hezonn wears this fact proudly. Not only limiting himself to assisting 4th, he spreads his talents and ferocity to the entire community to assist them with completing their missions.
Living for battle, Hezonn dons the Bladeguard Veteran weapon set to protect his brothers while defeating the enemies of Man.

title: 5th Company — The Dark Krakens
subtitle: Abyssal hunters defined by challenge, controlled aggression, and immaculate warplate.
keywords: dark krakens naktis ocean successor cob dragonborn toeknee

sections.h: We are the Dark Krakens, as inexorable as the tide itself!
p: Hailing from Naktis, the Dark Krakens are a Salamanders successor Chapter that makes its home in the depths of its ocean world. Drawn to the biggest threats, the hardest targets, and the most dangerous battles — this company is one for those that desire demanding challenges.
Transfers are selective, and entrants are vetted heavily. Calm beneath pressure, ruthless on the hunt.

notables: Cob, Master of the Marches

Initially serving as our Master of Recruits, he was interred when he chose to step down. As our first Venerable Dreadnought, he was kept awake to guide several captains to their current positions. He was also instrumental in the Dark Krakens' return to our community.
Choosing a mix of combat styles, you will frequently find him either with a Hellblaster or in the melee beside his beloved Krakens.
Lieutenant Dragonborn
Former Lieutenant of 7th Company, he returned to the Dark Krakens upon their formation. A veteran of multiple Deathwatch tours, he is skilled enough to take any situation and flex it to his needs.
Favoring his Intercessor toolkit, he prefers the heavier Hellblaster plasma cannon.
Lieutenant Toeknee

The friendly face amongst the sea of hardened warriors belies lethal intent and ability. Another formative member of the Krakens, this time from 2nd Company. He was the first in the server to receive the onerous title of "Sergeant at Arms."
As a Reiver, he prefers to launch himself behind enemy lines to take out high-value targets, and those requesting reinforcements.

title: 6th Company — Covenant of Fire
subtitle: A devout Chapter shaped by hardship, scholarship, and endurance.
keywords: covenant fire vokar escanor hierocles templar zeal scholars relics

sections.h: Adversity isn't the enemy, it's the process
p: The Covenant of Fire is our newest addition, replacing our reserve company and breathing new life into the Company. They carry not only the legacy of Vulkan into battle, but also act as warrior scholars.

Utterly dedicated to the preservation of truth and the Imperium's history, they destroy anything deemed heretical with similar zeal. Their flames serve as a beacon of comfort for allies, while simultaneously marking the destruction of their enemies.

notables: Captain Escanor Vo'kar
Initially starting as a Scout Sergeant turned Apothecary, Vo'kar has shown steadfast commitment and resilience as a Reiver, prioritizing high-value targets behind enemy front lines.
As the Master of Relics, he stands as the guard for the technical marvels that our father uncovered, and that are still deployed to battle.
As Head of the Covenant of Fire, his is the youngest company among the Salamanders, yet they adhere to the Promethean Creed with unrelenting zeal.
Reclusiarch Hierocles
Long-standing Reclusiarch since before the rebrand as the Covenant of Fire. Serves as a font of morale for the company, delivering litanies of inspiration and zeal.
He favors the Intercessor toolset to complement his crozius.
Lieutenant Templar
6th Company's Bladeguard, he is dedicated to both physical and metaphysical defense for his brothers.
Always available for support, Templar is dedicated to using his might to defend his brothers in the face of threats from the material and immaterial world.

title: 7th Scout Company — The Sons of Nocturne
subtitle: Reconnaissance, patience, leadership, and the forging of new battle-brothers.
keywords: sons nocturne scouts reconnaissance snipers eliminator tactical intercessor vanguard reiver training leefee jones artorios

p: The Sons of Nocturne embody patience and leadership as the reconnaissance company of the Chapter. They train Scouts in the tactics and strategies needed to destroy the enemies of the Imperium efficiently while being forged through battle.

The company includes many Eliminators, Intercessors, and Reivers. Its leaders select engagements methodically for maximum effect, specializing in infiltration, reconnaissance, and assassination while providing Scouts with a stable home in which to learn and grow.
Outside combat, the company command is known for calm, patience, compassion, and quiet support for the Scouts in its care.

notables: Captain Leefee
Our long-serving and hard working Master of Recruits, his Company is the start of every Salamander's journey.
As the Captain of 7th Company, he ensures that recruits have the best possible initial experience in the community, and assists them with moving onto their companies in the future.
If you ever get a chance, ask him about Devil May Cry.
Lieutenant Jones
The ever present backbone of 7th Company, Lieutenant Jones tirelessly works behind the scenes to ensure that 7th continues to run like a well-oiled machine.
Often clad in his Intercessor toolkit, he prefers to utilize close-quarters combat while marking out targets for prioritization.
Scout Sgt Artorios
The Bastion of 7th, frequently clad in his Bladeguard attire, he is dedicated to the defense of his brothers above all else.
Ever present and never far, he views it as his personal mission to support as many scouts through as many fires as possible, so that they may in turn help guide others through the fires of battle.

title: The Apothecarion of Nocturne
subtitle: Guardians of gene-seed, healers of the fallen, and keepers of the flame of life.
keywords: apothecarion biologis doly valairien vaylund talis geneseed gene-seed medics

sections.h: Vulkan lives, and through us, his fire shall never die
p: The Apothecaries guard the gene-seed and preserve the Chapter's future. On the battlefield they walk among the fallen, braving fire and fury to recover what cannot be replaced. From the teachings of Harath Shen, they carry compassion tempered by unflinching resolve.
The Apothecarion serves as more than a medical corps. It leads community engagement, organizes events, locates and secures gene-seed, and publishes guidance for the people of Nocturne.

notables: Chief Apothecary Doly
Head of the Apothecarion, Doly is overall in charge of it and all its members. Resolute in the face of all challenges, and always working on new creations or events for the community.
Leading by example, he frequently dons the retinue of a Bladeguard Veteran to ensure the safe return of the Chapter's gene-seed.
Biologis Valairien
Currently attached to 1st Company, Valairien is an ever present face helping scouts or helping to organize community events.
Providing support from afar, he is frequently found sporting a Multi-Melta or a Hellblaster.
Biologis Vaylund

Currently assigned to the Dark Krakens and Covenant of Fire, he prefers to do his work with a level head instead of the fire that Salamanders are traditionally known for. Generally ever present in the community, engaged in activity or not.
Generally splits his time between Reiver and Intercessor loadouts.
Biologis Talis
Attached to 2nd Company, Talis was instrumental in assisting the rebuild of its command structure. Favoring endurance challenges, he is frequently found assisting siege missions of all sorts.
As a Reiver, he is committed to picking apart the softer bits of the enemies that cower behind their fellows.

title: The Librarius
subtitle: Psychic guardians, scholars, and living conflagrations of the Chapter.
keywords: librarius librarian lexicanium codicier epistolary hampton vashquil ferrak knowledge war craft psyker

p: Librarians are responsible as keepers of wisdom and as shields against the horrors of the Immaterium. They are responsible as stewards of the Chapter's history, the bulwark against the warpspawn, and guides for brothers seeking wisdom of the mind, over wisdom of the soul.

Librarians will pick one of three specialties, each delivering a unique benefit to the chapter. Through guidance in these fields, they make sure the culture and spirit of the Salamanders is never forgotten.

list: Lexicanium — initiates taking their first steps through the Burning.
Codicier — battle-psykers proven by the Tempering Flame.
Epistolary — senior guides who survive the Crucible of Ash.
Chief Librarian — the mantle of wisdom and guardianship.

p: Focused on lore, philosophy, research, and calm debate. Its members seek answers, encourage social connection, and maintain a level head during disagreement.
Focused on Space Marine 2 and other Warhammer games. Its members pursue deep understanding of the game rather than simple meta chasing or build copying.
Focused on tabletop play, painting, modeling, and sharing the roots of the hobby. Its members create, teach, and demonstrate mastery of their craft.

notables: Chief Librarian Hampton
As Chief Librarian and head of the Librarius, Hampton is ultimately responsible for the wellbeing and safekeeping of the Salamanders' history and presence of their past.
Covering a range of situations, he chooses either an Eliminator toolset or he will go into battle up close, tearing enemies asunder as a Bladeguard.
Epistolary Vash'Quil

Fond of the great lizards of Old Terra, and knowledgeable of a galaxy far, far away — he's often found assisting scouts as his service continues. Attached to 7th Company, he is always around to make sure recruit needs are addressed readily.
Diving deep into the lore, Vash pores over tomes to provide answers to obscure questions that elude others.
Often found sporting the equipment of a Bladeguard Veteran.
Epistolary Fer'rak
As the Epistolary of War, his zeal is unmatchable. Tirelessly assisting brothers and recruits, he constantly stands ready to deliver death to the enemies of Man, and to ensure mission success.
Favoring the Intercessor loadout, he adapts his loadout to whichever situation his mission requires.

title: The Armoury
subtitle: Techmarines, forge masters, and keepers of the Chapter’s engines of war.
keywords: armoury techmarine forgemaster apollyon nod kixar beck ediicius byngo mechadendrite forge machine omnissiah

p: The Armoury sacrifices part of itself to the Machine God so that the Chapter may wield the wisdom and secrets of the Mechanicus. Behind every bolter is its wrath, behind every strike its fury, and behind every engine of vengeance its retribution.
Thanks to the Armoury's vigilance, machine spirits are brought to heel and our weapons continue to function at the peak of their abilities.

notables: Forgemaster Kix'ar

Our First Forgemaster, an early adopter of the shield bash strategy, and the original herald of the Power Fist. Kix'ar is a longtime member of the community, and has long provided his support and guidance to the Captains and other leadership.
Forgemaster Apollyon

Preferring to dispatch his enemies up close, he is only ever found directly in the thickest of the fighting. His preferred weapon is the Thunder Hammer, emulating the strength and fury of his gene-father.
Forgemaster Nod
Tirelessly forging builds, and putting the community through its paces — Nod excels at ensuring the community members are as sharp going into battle as their weapons are.
Mechadendrite Experts

These are the recipients of the highest honor in the Armoury, and serve as the right hands of the Forgemasters. This is earned through submitting numerous builds, testing builds, assisting others with creating builds, and peerless knowledge of the stats of weapons used in battle:
Techmarine Beck, 1st Company — First to achieve Immortalis Vigili, early apostle of the Block cult.
Techmarine Ediicius, 2nd Company — First to achieve Peritus Comperio, preacher of the Combat Knife.
Techmarine Byn'go, 3rd Company — Leagues of Votann enjoyer, favors heavy weapons and their cousin, even heavier weapons.

title: The Reclusiam — Keepers of Faith
subtitle: The vigilant eyes, guiding hands, and unwavering judgment of the Chapter.
keywords: reclusiam reclusiarch oron tracyn gilga flusht chaplain judiciar

p: The Reclusiam shapes warriors, guides the faithful, and carries the Emperor's will into every battle. They are charged with overseeing the spiritual welfare of the Chapter, as well as delivering lessons on the Promethean Creed.

notables: Lord Chaplain Flusht
Along with the Chapter Master and the Pyre Guard, forms the final piece of the leadership for the community at large. Serves as counsel to Vulkan, the Pyre Guard, and the Chapter Master.
As the lead chaplain, Flusht is also in charge of 4th Company. Serving as the home for our Igniax chaplains, as well as a home for our chaplains when they are unassigned from a community.
Frequently seen in the melee, he prefers to lead from the front. Smiting enemies with his crozius and inspiring fellow Salamanders onto greater heights.
Reclusiarch Tra'cyn — 3rd Company
Preferring to stay in the melee, he prioritizes his Reiver loadout — delivering death swiftly while inspiring those around him.
Ever present and available to assist new recruits, also frequently brings new aspirants into the fold of the Reclusiam.
Reclusiarch Or'on — 1st Company
The first chaplain to be accepted into First Company, and a long time veteran of the community, Or'on is the embodiment of perseverance and strength as prescribed in the Promethean Creed.
Equipped as a Bladeguard, he exchanges the weapon for his crozius.
Reclusiarch Gilga — 5th Company
Reclusiarch for the Krakens, Gilga is known for his ability to resolve disputes and maintain a level head when tensions are high.
Often sporting a heavy bolter, Gilga prefers to match his giant prey with equally giant weapons.
